items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Now, they had this little cat, Jazzbo. ... a great entertainer.

ctx.x: Yeah. Double-breasted chick. Heh. Well, they had what you call ups. Now, they had this little cat, Jazzbo. You'll see a picture in magazine...in a book of a cabaret scene. I think Tiny Parham is in it in a magazine, one of them history books, of a revue in either the Grand Terrace or the Royal Garden. And there's a little-bitty guy there, Jazzbo, a great entertainer. He could equally sing with two voices, a soprano like a woman, then turn and sing like a baritone, like a man.
Oh yes, yes. I remember that.
